Tequila Chicken
By: Sheri Wetherell
Published: Sunday, February 14, 2010 - 1:50am

Ingredients




1/2 cup tequila
Juice 1 fresh lime (can use lemon)
2 teaspoons finely chopped garlic
3 tablespoons orange blossom honey, or to taste
3 chicken breasts, each cut in half

Preparation

1 Stir sauce ingredients together well, mixing until honey dissolves. Place chicken halves in sauce, one at a time, turning to coat. Let marinate 30-45 minutes. Grill 12-15 minutes per side over medium coals, basting frequently with marinade. Throw away any leftover marinade. RDJ - Cyn
